label: What a resumable job says when it starts again, keeps a part, or stops

params.name: resumed
params.default: carrying on from step {n} of {total} - {done} already made and kept

params.name: kept
params.default: step {n} of {total} kept from the last run

params.name: stopped_budget
params.default: Stopped before step {n} of {total}: {left} is left of your budget and that step needs about {need}. {ready} of {total} made so far are kept and can be played. The rest would cost about {rest} - top up, raise the budget in Account & key, then press the same button to carry on.

params.name: stopped_error
params.default: Stopped at step {n} of {total}: {reason}. {ready} of {total} made so far are kept - press the same button to carry on from there.

params.name: stopped_by_you
params.default: Stopped by you after step {ready} of {total}. Everything made so far is kept - press the same button to carry on.

params.name: stopped_partial
params.default: Only the steps asked for were made: {ready} of {total} ready. Press the same button to make the rest.

params.name: stopped_restart
params.default: The server restarted during this job after step {ready} of {total}. Everything made so far is kept - press the same button to carry on.

params.name: stopped_no_credit
params.default: Stopped at step {n} of {total}: {reason} {ready} of {total} made so far are kept. Add credit with that provider (or add another key in Account & key), then press the same button - the work carries on from step {n}, nothing is paid for twice.

description_nl: Every sentence a resumable job says. {n} is the step it is at, {total} how many there are, {done} how many were already made, {ready} the last step that can be played, {left} {need} {rest} are dollars.
